title: Local essential bound for the tangential Jacobian ‖L_#ξ‖ (parent Step 2)
statement: Let P, Q, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, (M, θ, ξ) with IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ, f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q locally Lipschitz on U, and L : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^Q). Assume the derivative clause: for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x, every subspace T_x with HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x T_x and every v ∈ T_x, the map t ↦ f(x + t v) has derivative L(x)v at t = 0. Then for every compact K ⊆ U there is C ∈ ℝ such that ‖L(x)_#ξ(x)‖ ≤ C for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x with x ∈ K.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Tx : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Tx → ∀ v ∈ Tx, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (x + t • v)) (L x v) 0) → ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), x ∈ K → ‖nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x)‖ ≤ C
